summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Conciliación por cuenta' panel on /admin/payment-accounts (admin cookie test_session_admin_X). Everything requested passed. The section renders below Daily totals with 6 columns, per-currency cards (EUR/USD/USDT) and rows that match GET reconciliation-summary. Server date is 2026-10-31 and the seed records are dated 2026-03, so to check the seed values I used Playwright request interception to change the request to days=365. With that, pa_seed_eur showed 100 confirmed with deposits 50/50, and __unassigned__USDT showed the label 'Sin asignar · USDT' / 'Unassigned · USDT' with the amber bg-amber-500/5 class, 100 confirmed, 12 pending and deposits 0/100. The raw key never appears. Each range button (7/14/30/90) fires exactly one request with the correct days value, the active style updates, and the table reloads (empty state at 7/14/30, 1 row at 90). CSV export downloads conciliacion_por_cuenta_<ts>.csv with the exact requested header, unassigned rows read 'Sin asignar · USDT', and the 'Exportado (CSV)' toast appears. i18n ES<->EN via admin-lang-switcher translates the title, helper, headers, unassigned label, cards, warning and legend. Regression: the accounts table (3 seed rows) and the daily-totals-section still render.

issues: Rows for accounts missing from the payment_accounts catalog (e.g. payacc_usd_zelle50, is_active=null, with 21 pending ops worth 1,850 USD) show no 'deleted/not in catalog' badge. The inactive badge only shows when is_active === false. Consider a 'deleted' indicator so admins don't hunt for a non-existent account.
The longest range is 90 days, so older inbound money (e.g. seed data from 2026-03) cannot be reconciled from the UI. Consider adding a 365-day or custom range if needed.
Legend text uses text-neutral-600 at 0.65rem on a near-black background, which has low contrast.

action_items: Optional: badge orphaned accounts (is_active null / not in catalog) in the recon table
Optional: add a longer range (e.g. 365 days) to the recon panel
Optional: raise the contrast of the legend line
critical_code_review_comments: The ReconciliationByAccountSection fetch .catch silently replaces data with empty arrays and shows no error toast. A 403 or 500 looks like 'Sin entradas en este período', which is misleading for reconciliation.
The CSV filename and header are always Spanish regardless of UI language. This matches the spec, but you may want to note it for EN users.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing seed_co_fixes_smoke data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server clock is 2026-10-31 and the seed records are dated 2026-03, so seed rows only appear with days>=245. In Playwright, use page.route('**/reconciliation-summary**') to rewrite days=365. The admin language is synced to the server profile; when switching language, click admin-lang-switcher and wait about 2s, retrying if needed (a race with profile load can swallow the first click). The language was restored to ES at the end.
